bear_case: WTI is +2.9% to $99 this morning as Iran deal optimism dissolves — a 3% oil move before markets open is the signature of a geopolitical variable that is not fully priced. SpaceX's S-1 filing formally starts the 12-session countdown to the largest institutional capital drain in equity market history, arriving precisely as AI-sector multiples are stretched and the 30Y refuses to clear 5.05%. The quantum computing rally in RGTI and IONQ on government equity stakes is a government-directed price signal, not market-driven demand; if these names fade 30-40% into the weekend, Friday's positive futures close reverses and Tuesday's open reveals a failed breakout. If SPX closes below 7,400 with the 30Y above 5.15% on Tuesday May 26, HOLD converts immediately to Step Aside and the NVDA consolidation entry is abandoned.
